Seasons.Text: The year in Stardew Valley is divided into 4 seasons of 28 days each:

Spring.Name: Spring
Spring.Description: Mild weather with pleasant rain showers.

Summer.Name: Summer
Summer.Description: Warm, sunny days with occasional thunderstorms.

Fall.Name: Fall
Fall.Description: Cool and crisp weather with colorful foliage and light rain.

Winter.Name: Winter
Winter.Description: Cold and snowy conditions where outdoor crops do not grow natively.

Locations.Text: Key locations and points of interest across the valley include:

TheFarm.Name: The Farm
TheFarm.Description: The farmer's home and primary homestead. Features farm structures like the Barn, Coop, Greenhouse, Silo, Stable, Shed, and Fish Pond.

PelicanTown_SeedShop.Name: Pierre's General Store
PelicanTown_SeedShop.Description: Local shop selling seeds and supplies. Owned by Pierre, who lives here with Caroline and Abigail.

PelicanTown_JojaMart.Name: JojaMart
PelicanTown_JojaMart.Description: A mega-corporate supermarket competing with Pierre's. Employs Shane, Sam, and Manager Morris.

PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Name: Stardrop Saloon
PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Description: The local social hub owned and managed by Gus, assisted by Emily. Features food, drinks, pool, and arcade games.

PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Name: Harvey's Clinic
PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Description: Town medical clinic run by Dr. Harvey, with Maru working part-time as a nurse.

PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Name: Blacksmith
PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Description: Run by Clint, who processes geodes and upgrades farming tools.

PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Name: Library & Museum
PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Description: Curated by Gunther. Houses donated artifacts, minerals, and lost books.

PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Name: Community Center
PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Description: The historic heart of town, currently neglected. Can be restored by Junimos or turned into a Joja Warehouse.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: Lush forest housing Leah's Cottage, Marnie's Ranch, and the Wizard's Tower. The Travelling Cart visits Fridays and Sundays.

CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Name: Marnie's Ranch
CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Description: Sells livestock and animal supplies. Marnie lives here with Jas and Shane.

CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Name: Wizard's Tower
CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Description: Home of M. Rasmodius the Wizard. Most villagers view it with local curiosity or superstition.

Mountain.Name: Mountain
Mountain.Description: Scenic northern area featuring Robin's Carpenter Shop, Linus's tent, the Mines, and the Adventurer's Guild.

Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Name: Adventurer's Guild
Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Description: Headquarters for local monster hunters, managed by Marlon and Gil.

Mountain_TheMines.Name: The Mines
Mountain_TheMines.Description: Deep, cavernous mines filled with ores, minerals, and monsters. Explored by adventurous villagers.

Mountain_Spa.Name: Spa
Mountain_Spa.Description: A bathhouse near the railroad. Its thermal pool restores energy and health.

Beach_FishShop.Name: Fish Shop
Beach_FishShop.Description: Willy's seaside shop selling fishing gear and tackle. Features a boat to Ginger Island once repaired.

Desert_Oasis.Name: Oasis
Desert_Oasis.Description: Sandy's shop in the Calico Desert selling exotic seeds and goods. Accessible via the repaired Desert Bus.

GingerIsland.Name: Ginger Island
GingerIsland.Description: A tropical paradise featuring an island farm, beach resort, and volcano dungeon.

Festivals.Text: Pelican Town hosts several seasonal community festivals throughout the year:

spring13.Name: Egg Festival
spring13.Description: Spring 13. Features an egg hunt competition.

spring24.Name: Flower Dance
spring24.Description: Spring 24. A traditional spring dance where players can ask an eligible villager to pair up.

summer11.Name: Luau
summer11.Description: Summer 11. A beachside potluck where villagers contribute ingredients to a communal soup for the Governor.

summer28.Name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
summer28.Description: Summer 28. An evening gathering at the beach to watch migrating bioluminescent jellyfish.

fall16.Name: Stardew Valley Fair
fall16.Description: Fall 16. A town fair with carnival minigames and the Grange Display contest.

fall27.Name: Spirit's Eve
fall27.Description: Fall 27. A spooky festival featuring a haunted maze and seasonal treats.

winter8.Name: Festival of Ice
winter8.Description: Winter 8. Features ice sculptures, igloos, and an ice fishing competition.

winter25.Name: Feast of the Winter Star
winter25.Description: Winter 25. A holiday celebration centered around secret gift-giving.
